correctness.rationale: Marker positions b^j-1 create explicit zero-runs. For b>=3, the newly maximal zero run beginning at b^s yields the first phrase; the next 0^d1 ends at the next marker and is absent at any earlier start by monotonic gaps. For b=2, the longest previous factor at start 2^(s-1) agrees until the second marker, where the next bit differs; all shorter prefixes occur earlier. Initial b=2,b=3,b>=4 cases and contiguous endpoints verified. Independent brute scan of all earlier starts and shorter-prefix occurrence for 96 complete phrases over bases 2..10 up to endpoint 5000; packaged 115-phrase checker source separately inspected. Finite checks corroborate the all-level gap proof.
